# Test case for M=3 to check Candidate B (N=0)
# T1: (10, 10, 1). G=10, P=10, O=1
# T2: (1, 1, 10). G=1, P=1, O=10
# T3: (10, 1, 1). G=10, P=1, O=1

G = [10, 1, 10]
P = [10, 1, 1]
O = [1, 10, 1]

# Sort descendingly
G.sort(reverse=True)
P.sort(reverse=True)
O.sort(reverse=True)

print(f"Sorted G: {G}")
print(f"Sorted P: {P}")
print(f"Sorted O: {O}")

failures = 0
for a in range(len(G)):
    g_a, p_a, o_a = G[a], P[a], O[a]
    
    # Check triangle inequality. Sort the triple internally to simplify the check.
    sides = sorted([g_a, p_a, o_a], reverse=True)
    s1, s2, s3 = sides[0], sides[1], sides[2]
    
    # A triangle fails if s1 >= s2 + s3
    if s1 >= s2 + s3:
        failures += 1
        print(f"Failure found at a={a+1}: ({g_a}, {p_a}, {o_a}). Sides sorted: ({s1}, {s2}, {s3}).")

print(f"Total failures for M=3: {failures}")
